issues: The README states requirements we cannot meet: '1-8 high-end NVIDIA GPUs with at least 12 GB of memory' and 'CUDA toolkit 11.1 or later' (README.md:55-57).

The README demo has a CUDA-only code path: gen_images.py:106 hard-codes `device = torch.device('cuda')`, so it cannot run on CPU without editing repo source. The recorded pass needed exactly that one-line patch (repo_diff: gen_images.py). By the rule applied at exam time (a README-stated GPU requirement plus CUDA-only code), this repo should have been excluded.
If it stays tested, the goal and oracle are otherwise fine: seeds 2,3 must give two 512x512 PNGs with std>20, and the goal gives no install hints beyond environment.yml's package names.
